data.title: Pre-aggregate child rows before joining parent in multi-table aggregations
data.lesson: When a parent-child join requires aggregation that must not be multiplied by the parent's row fan-out, pre-aggregate the child table (sum + group by parent key) inside a CTE and LEFT JOIN the aggregated set. Do not SUM a child column directly off a multi-row join without collapsing duplicates first, because fan-out from another join inflates totals. Apply when child rows are many-to-one per parent key and a SUM/COUNT is required on the child side. Do not apply when the child is guaranteed 1:1 with the join key or when the desired output is per-child rows rather than per-parent aggregates.

WITH first_view AS (
  SELECT person_id, MIN(event_time) AS view_at
  FROM funnel_events_tr_funnel_00
  WHERE event_type = 'view'
    AND event_time >= '2025-01-11 00:00:00'
    AND event_time < '2025-01-13 00:00:00'
  GROUP BY person_id
), first_cart AS (
  SELECT e.person_id, MIN(e.event_time) AS cart_at
  FROM funnel_events_tr_funnel_00 e
  JOIN first_view v ON v.person_id = e.person_id
  WHERE e.event_type = 'add_to_cart'
    AND e.event_time >= v.view_at
    AND e.event_time < '2025-01-13 00:00:00'
  GROUP BY e.person_id
), first_purchase AS (
  SELECT e.person_id, MIN(e.event_time) AS purchase_at
  FROM funnel_events_tr_funnel_00 e
  JOIN first_view v ON v.person_id = e.person_id
  WHERE e.event_type = 'purchase'
    AND e.event_time >= v.view_at
    AND e.event_time < '2025-01-13 00:00:00'
  GROUP BY e.person_id
)
SELECT
  p.person_id,
  v.view_at,
  c.cart_at,
  x.purchase_at,
  CASE WHEN v.person_id IS NOT NULL AND x.person_id IS NOT NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS converted
FROM people_tr_funnel_00 p
LEFT JOIN first_view v ON v.person_id = p.person_id
LEFT JOIN first_cart c ON c.person_id = p.person_id
LEFT JOIN first_purchase x ON x.person_id = p.person_id
ORDER BY p.person_id

data.lesson: When a contract caps a per-row amount at another per-row value (e.g. refunds at order gross) and sums across a parent group, do NOT sum child rows directly in the same pass as the cap. data.title: Latest event per entity needs tie-break ordering, not MAX alone
data.lesson: When selecting the latest event per entity, MAX(event_time) alone is insufficient: ties on event_time and seq must be broken deterministically, and status filtering must apply BEFORE choosing the latest, not after. Use ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY entity_id ORDER BY event_time DESC, seq ASC, event_id DESC) restricted to rn=1, applying all eligibility filters (cutoff, status whitelist) in the same CTE. Boundary: do not use this pattern when the task requires ALL latest events per entity or when no deterministic tie-break columns exist.

WITH ranked AS (
  SELECT s.entity_id, s.event_time, s.seq, s.status,
         ROW_NUMBER() OVER (
           PARTITION BY s.entity_id
           ORDER BY s.event_time DESC, s.seq ASC, s.event_id DESC
         ) AS rn
  FROM status_events_tr_latest_03 s
  JOIN entities_tr_latest_03 e ON e.entity_id = s.entity_id
  WHERE s.event_time <= '2025-01-13 12:00:00'
     AND s.status IN ('draft', 'ready', 'approved', 'queued', 'running', 'done', 'paused')
)
SELECT e.entity_id, r.status, r.event_time, r.seq
FROM entities_tr_latest_03 e
LEFT JOIN ranked r ON r.entity_id = e.entity_id AND r.rn = 1

ORDER BY e.entity_id

WITH qualifying_orders AS (
  SELECT order_id, account_id, gross_cents
  FROM orders_tr_agg_04
  WHERE status = 'paid' AND currency = 'USD'
),
order_refunds AS (
  SELECT r.order_id, SUM(r.refund_cents) AS refund_cents
  FROM refunds_tr_agg_04 r
  INNER JOIN qualifying_orders qo ON qo.order_id = r.order_id
  WHERE r.refund_status = 'posted'
  GROUP BY r.order_id
)
SELECT a.account_id,
       COUNT(qo.order_id) AS paid_order_count,
       COALESCE(SUM(qo.gross_cents), 0) AS gross_cents,
       COALESCE(SUM(orf.refund_cents), 0) AS refund_cents,
       COALESCE(SUM(qo.gross_cents), 0) - COALESCE(SUM(orf.refund_cents), 0) AS net_cents,
       CASE WHEN COALESCE(SUM(qo.gross_cents), 0) = 0 THEN NULL
            ELSE ROUND(COALESCE(SUM(orf.refund_cents), 0) * 100.0 / SUM(qo.gross_cents), 6) END AS refund_rate_pct
FROM accounts_tr_agg_04 a
LEFT JOIN qualifying_orders qo ON qo.account_id = a.account_id
LEFT JOIN order_refunds orf ON orf.order_id = qo.order_id
WHERE a.region = 'west'
GROUP BY a.account_id
ORDER BY a.account_id

WITH qualifying_orders AS (
  SELECT order_id, account_id, gross_cents
  FROM orders_tr_agg_04
  WHERE status = 'paid' AND currency = 'USD'

order_refunds AS (
  SELECT r.order_id, SUM(r.refund_cents) AS refund_cents
  FROM refunds_tr_agg_04 r

  WHERE r.refund_status = 'posted'
  GROUP BY r.order_id
)
SELECT a.account_id,
       COUNT(qo.order_id) AS paid_order_count,
       COALESCE(SUM(qo.gross_cents), 0) AS gross_cents,
       COALESCE(SUM(orf.refund_cents), 0) AS refund_cents,
       COALESCE(SUM(qo.gross_cents), 0) - COALESCE(SUM(orf.refund_cents), 0) AS net_cents,
       CASE WHEN COALESCE(SUM(qo.gross_cents), 0) = 0 THEN NULL

LEFT JOIN qualifying_orders qo ON qo.account_id = a.account_id
LEFT JOIN order_refunds orf ON orf.order_id = qo.order_id
WHERE a.region = 'west'
GROUP BY a.account_id

WITH considered_orders AS (

  FROM orders_tr_agg_05 o
  WHERE o.status IN ('paid', 'settled')
    AND o.currency = 'USD'
    AND o.gross_cents <> 0
    AND EXISTS (
      SELECT 1 FROM refunds_tr_agg_05 r
      WHERE r.order_id = o.order_id AND r.refund_status = 'posted'
    )
),
order_refunds AS (
  SELECT r.order_id, SUM(r.refund_cents) AS refund_cents
  FROM refunds_tr_agg_05 r
  WHERE r.refund_status = 'posted'
    AND r.order_id IN (SELECT order_id FROM considered_orders)
  GROUP BY r.order_id
),
order_metrics AS (
  SELECT co.order_id, co.account_id, co.gross_cents, COALESCE(orf.refund_cents, 0) AS refund_cents
  FROM considered_orders co
  LEFT JOIN order_refunds orf ON orf.order_id = co.order_id
)
SELECT a.account_id,
       COUNT(om.order_id) AS paid_order_count,
       COALESCE(SUM(om.gross_cents), 0) AS gross_cents,
       COALESCE(SUM(om.refund_cents), 0) AS refund_cents,
       COALESCE(SUM(om.gross_cents), 0) - COALESCE(SUM(om.refund_cents), 0) AS net_cents,
       CASE WHEN COALESCE(SUM(om.gross_cents), 0) = 0 THEN NULL
            ELSE ROUND(SUM(om.refund_cents) * 100.0 / SUM(om.gross_cents), 6) END AS refund_rate_pct
FROM accounts_tr_agg_05 a
LEFT JOIN order_metrics om ON om.account_id = a.account_id
WHERE a.region = 'north'
GROUP BY a.account_id

WITH qualifying_orders AS (
  SELECT o.order_id, o.account_id, o.gross_cents
  FROM orders_tr_agg_07 o
  WHERE o.status IN ('paid', 'settled')
    AND o.currency = 'USD'
    AND EXISTS (
      SELECT 1 FROM refunds_tr_agg_07 r
      WHERE r.order_id = o.order_id AND r.refund_status = 'posted'
    )
),
order_refund_totals AS (
  SELECT q.order_id, q.account_id, q.gross_cents,
         MIN(COALESCE(SUM(r.refund_cents), 0), q.gross_cents) AS capped_refund_cents
  FROM qualifying_orders q
  LEFT JOIN refunds_tr_agg_07 r ON r.order_id = q.order_id AND r.refund_status = 'posted'
  GROUP BY q.order_id, q.account_id, q.gross_cents
),
order_agg AS (
  SELECT ort.account_id,
         COUNT(ort.order_id) AS paid_order_count,
         SUM(ort.gross_cents) AS gross_cents,
         SUM(ort.capped_refund_cents) AS refund_cents
  FROM order_refund_totals ort
  GROUP BY ort.account_id
)
SELECT a.account_id,
       COALESCE(oa.paid_order_count, 0) AS paid_order_count,
       COALESCE(oa.gross_cents, 0) AS gross_cents,
       COALESCE(oa.refund_cents, 0) AS refund_cents,
       COALESCE(oa.gross_cents, 0) - COALESCE(oa.refund_cents, 0) AS net_cents,
       CASE WHEN COALESCE(oa.gross_cents, 0) = 0 THEN NULL
            ELSE ROUND(oa.refund_cents * 100.0 / oa.gross_cents, 6)
       END AS refund_rate_pct
FROM accounts_tr_agg_07 a
LEFT JOIN order_agg oa ON oa.account_id = a.account_id
WHERE a.region = 'west'
ORDER BY a.account_id;

data.lesson: When a metric (e.g., refund_cents) is capped per parent row (MIN(sum, parent_value)) and that cap depends on a one-to-one row, never compute it in a single GROUP BY with the parent. Multi-row joins multiply the parent before aggregation; SUM(per-row cap) overestimates. Boundary: do NOT apply when the cap is inherently row-bounded (each child row never exceeds the parent, e.g., line-item <= order total already enforced upstream) or when child-to-parent is one-to-one by design; then direct MIN per row is safe.

data.title: Funnel conversion flag must require all stages present
data.lesson: For multi-stage funnel outputs, the converted flag must be true only when every stage timestamp is non-null. A common bug is using MAX(event_time) for the earliest qualifying event, producing the latest in-window timestamp and breaking downstream strict greater-than joins. Use MIN for 'first' stages and compute conversion as the conjunction of all stage non-null checks. Do not apply when conversion is defined by a single dominant stage or when null in any stage still counts as converted.

WITH qualifying_orders AS (
  SELECT order_id, account_id, gross_cents
  FROM orders_te_agg_04
  WHERE status = 'paid'
    AND currency IN ('USD', 'EUR')
    AND gross_cents <> 0
),
posted_refunds AS (
  SELECT r.order_id, SUM(r.refund_cents) AS refund_cents
  FROM refunds_te_agg_04 r
  JOIN qualifying_orders qo ON qo.order_id = r.order_id
  WHERE r.refund_status = 'posted'
  GROUP BY r.order_id
)
SELECT a.account_id,
       COUNT(qo.order_id) AS paid_order_count,
       COALESCE(SUM(qo.gross_cents), 0) AS gross_cents,
       COALESCE(pr.refund_cents, 0) AS refund_cents,
       COALESCE(SUM(qo.gross_cents), 0) - COALESCE(pr.refund_cents, 0) AS net_cents,
       CASE WHEN COALESCE(SUM(qo.gross_cents), 0) = 0 THEN NULL
            ELSE ROUND(COALESCE(pr.refund_cents, 0) * 100.0 / SUM(qo.gross_cents), 6)
       END AS refund_rate_pct
FROM accounts_te_agg_04 a
LEFT JOIN qualifying_orders qo ON qo.account_id = a.account_id
LEFT JOIN posted_refunds pr ON pr.order_id = qo.order_id
WHERE a.region = 'west'
GROUP BY a.account_id, pr.refund_cents
ORDER BY a.account_id

  FROM orders_te_agg_04
  WHERE status = 'paid'

WITH selected_accounts AS (
  SELECT account_id FROM accounts_te_agg_03 WHERE region = 'east'
), paid_orders AS (
  SELECT order_id, account_id, gross_cents
  FROM orders_te_agg_03
  WHERE status IN ('paid', 'settled') AND currency IN ('USD', 'EUR')
), refund_totals AS (
  SELECT order_id, SUM(refund_cents) AS refund_cents, COUNT(*) AS refund_rows
  FROM refunds_te_agg_03
  WHERE refund_status = 'posted'
  GROUP BY order_id
), considered_orders AS (
  SELECT p.order_id, p.account_id, p.gross_cents, COALESCE(r.refund_cents, 0) AS refund_cents,
         COALESCE(r.refund_rows, 0) AS refund_rows
  FROM paid_orders p
  LEFT JOIN refund_totals r ON r.order_id = p.order_id
  WHERE COALESCE(r.refund_rows, 0) > 0
), per_account AS (
  SELECT c.account_id,
         COUNT(*) AS paid_order_count,
         SUM(c.gross_cents) AS gross_cents,
         SUM(MIN(c.refund_cents, c.gross_cents)) AS refund_cents
  FROM considered_orders c
  GROUP BY c.account_id
)
SELECT a.account_id,
       COALESCE(x.paid_order_count, 0) AS paid_order_count,
       COALESCE(x.gross_cents, 0) AS gross_cents,
       COALESCE(x.refund_cents, 0) AS refund_cents,
       COALESCE(x.gross_cents, 0) - COALESCE(x.refund_cents, 0) AS net_cents,
       CASE WHEN COALESCE(x.gross_cents, 0) = 0 THEN NULL
            ELSE ROUND(COALESCE(x.refund_cents, 0) * 100.0 / x.gross_cents, 6) END AS refund_rate_pct
FROM selected_accounts a
JOIN per_account x ON x.account_id = a.account_id
ORDER BY a.account_id

WITH selected_accounts AS (

), paid_orders AS (
  SELECT order_id, account_id, gross_cents
  FROM orders_te_agg_00
  WHERE status IN ('paid') AND currency IN ('USD', 'EUR')

  SELECT order_id, SUM(refund_cents) AS refund_cents, COUNT(*) AS refund_rows
  FROM refunds_te_agg_00
  WHERE refund_status = 'posted'
  GROUP BY order_id
), considered_orders AS (
  SELECT p.order_id, p.account_id, p.gross_cents, COALESCE(r.refund_cents, 0) AS refund_cents,
         COALESCE(r.refund_rows, 0) AS refund_rows
  FROM paid_orders p
  LEFT JOIN refund_totals r ON r.order_id = p.order_id
  WHERE 1 = 1
), per_account AS (
  SELECT c.account_id,
         COUNT(*) AS paid_order_count,
         SUM(c.gross_cents) AS gross_cents,
         SUM(c.refund_cents) AS refund_cents
  FROM considered_orders c
  GROUP BY c.account_id
)
SELECT a.account_id,
       COALESCE(x.paid_order_count, 0) AS paid_order_count,
       COALESCE(x.gross_cents, 0) AS gross_cents,

  SELECT s.entity_id, s.event_time, s.seq, s.status,
         ROW_NUMBER() OVER (
           PARTITION BY s.entity_id
           ORDER BY s.event_time DESC, s.seq DESC, s.event_id DESC

  FROM status_events_te_latest_05 s
  JOIN entities_te_latest_05 e ON e.entity_id = s.entity_id
  WHERE s.event_time < '2025-01-15 12:00:00'
    AND e.is_active = 1
    AND s.status IN ('draft', 'ready', 'approved', 'queued', 'running', 'done', 'paused')
)
SELECT e.entity_id, r.status, r.event_time, r.seq
FROM entities_te_latest_05 e
LEFT JOIN ranked r ON r.entity_id = e.entity_id AND r.rn = 1
WHERE e.is_active = 1
ORDER BY e.entity_id

WITH in_window AS (
  SELECT person_id, event_type, event_time, channel
  FROM funnel_events_te_funnel_06
  WHERE event_time >= '2025-01-11 00:00:00'
    AND event_time < '2025-01-13 00:00:00'
    AND channel = 'web'

  JOIN in_window w

  WHERE w.event_type = 'purchase'
  GROUP BY c.person_id
)

FROM people_te_funnel_06 p
LEFT JOIN first_view v ON v.person_id = p.person_id
LEFT JOIN first_cart c ON c.person_id = p.person_id

WITH selected_accounts AS (
  SELECT account_id FROM accounts_te_agg_07 WHERE region = 'west'
), paid_orders AS (
  SELECT order_id, account_id, gross_cents
  FROM orders_te_agg_07
  WHERE status IN ('paid', 'settled') AND currency IN ('USD', 'EUR') AND gross_cents <> 0
), refund_totals AS (
  SELECT order_id, SUM(refund_cents) AS refund_cents, COUNT(*) AS refund_rows
  FROM refunds_te_agg_07
  WHERE refund_status = 'posted'
  GROUP BY order_id
), considered_orders AS (
  SELECT p.order_id, p.account_id, p.gross_cents, COALESCE(r.refund_cents, 0) AS refund_cents,
         COALESCE(r.refund_rows, 0) AS refund_rows
  FROM paid_orders p
  LEFT JOIN refund_totals r ON r.order_id = p.order_id
  WHERE COALESCE(r.refund_rows, 0) > 0
), per_account AS (
  SELECT c.account_id,
         COUNT(*) AS paid_order_count,
         SUM(c.gross_cents) AS gross_cents,
         SUM(MIN(c.refund_cents, c.gross_cents)) AS refund_cents
  FROM considered_orders c
  GROUP BY c.account_id
)
SELECT a.account_id,
       COALESCE(x.paid_order_count, 0) AS paid_order_count,
       COALESCE(x.gross_cents, 0) AS gross_cents,
       COALESCE(x.refund_cents, 0) AS refund_cents,
       COALESCE(x.gross_cents, 0) - COALESCE(x.refund_cents, 0) AS net_cents,
       CASE WHEN COALESCE(x.gross_cents, 0) = 0 THEN NULL
            ELSE ROUND(COALESCE(x.refund_cents, 0) * 100.0 / x.gross_cents, 6) END AS refund_rate_pct
FROM selected_accounts a
LEFT JOIN per_account x ON x.account_id = a.account_id
ORDER BY a.account_id
